description: SKY HUNTER SURVIVAL by DCR STUDIOS= D.CHAITHRADEEP RANA ,  Pilot a futuristic sky-hunter drone through endless skies. Tap to fly, dodge moving gates and floating mines, and collect coins. You have 3 lives, and the game gets faster every few seconds. Beat your saved best score. Works on PC and mobile, right in your browser. HUNT • DODGE • SURVIVE
